media_note: Each post = a Pip quote-card in the locked format (accent keyword + heart sub-line, golden-hour scene). Card IMAGE is pending the real Pip raw art (see ../../BLOCKERS.md). Text/caption/schedule are ready now.

posts.quote_main: Be proud of how far you've come.
posts.scene: Pip on a hilltop path at golden hour, looking back down the trail
posts.caption: A little reminder to look back and see how far you've come. 💛 You did that.

posts.quote_main: You are stronger than you think.
posts.scene: Pip standing in a breezy meadow, arms up
posts.caption: On the days it doesn't feel like it — you're stronger than you think. 🌱

posts.quote_main: Small steps every day lead to big changes.
posts.scene: Pip taking one small step along a stepping-stone path
posts.caption: Tiny steps still count. Keep going, one little step at a time. 🐾

posts.quote_main: It's okay to have hard days.
posts.scene: Pip under a gentle rain, calm, small umbrella
posts.caption: Hard days are allowed. They pass, and you're still here. ☔ Save this for one.

posts.quote_main: You don't have to be perfect to be amazing.
posts.scene: Pip in a wildflower field at sunset
posts.caption: You don't have to be perfect. You're already enough. 🌼

posts.quote_main: Take time to rest.
posts.scene: Pip napping on a big leaf hammock, golden light
posts.caption: This is your permission slip to rest. You've earned it. 😴

posts.quote_main: It's okay to ask for help.
posts.scene: Two little sprouts beside Pip (silhouettes), warm light — Pip foreground
posts.caption: Asking for help is brave, not weak. You're not alone in this. 🤍

posts.quote_main: Choose joy every day.
posts.scene: Pip chasing a butterfly through tall grass
posts.caption: Little joys count. Choose one today — you're worth it. 🦋

posts.quote_main: Be a light for someone today.
posts.scene: Pip holding a small warm lantern at dusk
posts.caption: One kind word can light up someone's whole day. Be that today. 🏮

posts.quote_main: Trust the timing of your life.
posts.scene: Pip watching a sunrise over rolling hills
posts.caption: You're not behind. Trust your timing — good things grow slowly. 🌅

posts.quote_main: You are someone's reason to smile.
posts.scene: Pip waving, cheeks rosy, sunset field
posts.caption: Someone smiled today because you exist. Thank you for being you. 😊

posts.quote_main: Rest is okay.
posts.scene: Pip curled under an autumn tree, leaves falling
posts.caption: Slowing down isn't quitting. Rest, recharge, grow. 🍂

posts.quote_main: You bring light.
posts.scene: Pip surrounded by tiny fireflies at twilight
posts.caption: The world's a little brighter with you in it. Shine on. ✨

posts.quote_main: Every day is a fresh start.
posts.scene: Pip watering a tiny sprout in the morning light
posts.caption: Whatever yesterday was — today's a fresh start. Keep growing. 🌱

posts.quote_main: A little rain helps the flower grow.
posts.scene: Pip beside a blooming flower after rain, rainbow behind
posts.caption: The hard bits help you grow too. A little rain, then the bloom. 🌈

posts.quote_main: Even slow steps still carry you.
posts.scene: Pip walking a long winding path at golden hour
posts.caption: Slow is still forward. Every step is carrying you somewhere good. 🐌

posts.quote_main: One kind thought can change a whole day.
posts.scene: Pip offering a tiny heart-shaped leaf
posts.caption: One kind thought — for someone else, or for yourself — can change a whole day. 💛

posts.quote_main: You are here, and the world is better.
posts.scene: Pip standing small under a vast starry sky
posts.caption: You being here makes the world better. You matter more than you know. 🌟

posts.quote_main: Just like the trees, you belong here.
posts.scene: Pip among tall friendly trees, sun rays through leaves
posts.caption: You belong here — roots and all, just like the trees. 🌳

posts.quote_main: Kind words last a long time.
posts.scene: Pip whispering to a little bird on its shoulder
posts.caption: Kind words cost nothing and last forever. Share a few today. 🐦

posts.quote_main: Keep believing in yourself.
posts.quote_sub: The best is yet to come!
posts.scene: Pip on a cliff edge at sunrise, wind in the leafy sprout
posts.caption: Keep believing in yourself. The best really is yet to come. 🌄
